newsitem.title: USA: Omaha Mayor wins reelection by narrow margin.
newsitem.headline: Omaha Mayor wins reelection by narrow margin.

text.p: Omaha Mayor Hal Daub has won reelection by 878 votes over challenger Brenda Council out of more than 109,000 cast in unofficial election returns, a Douglas County election official said Wednesday.

While narrow, Daub's margin in unofficial returns is too great to require a free recount under Nebraska law with 1,410 absentee and conditional ballots from the entire county left to tabulate, election commissioner Margaret Jurgensen said.
A former four-term Republican U.S. representative from Omaha, Daub has served as mayor since January 1994.
